subject: Concerted Onboarding: Implementation MAP & Evaluation Cadence
messages:
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@verdanthealth.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena.morales@verdanthealth.com>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@vendornet.io>
Date: Fri, 1 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Concerted Onboarding: implementation plan request

Hi Nikhil —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Verdant is ready to move forward following signature. To keep procurement and our clinical ops teams happy we need a single implementation artifact that captures: the rollout sequence, canary & rollback criteria, migration waves, and the 8-week training cadence.

Can you share a proposed MAP (single sheet) plus an evaluation cadence we can review with our security team? SOC2 evidence is being pulled and we may have a short questionnaire next week.

Target: onboarding kickoff week of Sept 11. Is that feasible from your side?

Best —
Sanjay
Director, Integrations
Verdant Health

Attachments: none
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@verdanthealth.com>, Elena Morales <elena.morales@verdanthealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Sep 2028 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Concerted Onboarding: implementation plan request

Sanjay —

Appreciate the clarity. We can absolutely provide a single-sheet MAP plus a companion evaluation cadence. Quick notes up-front:
- Kickoff wk of Sept 11: OK if contract signature is complete by Sept 7 (we need final access + DNS window for canary).
- Canary window: 72 hours with automated traffic shift and health gates (latency, error rate, quality tests).
- Migration waves: 3 waves (10% / 40% / 100%) with fallbacks at each gate.
- Training: two 90-minute workshops + three office hours per wave; train-the-trainer available.

I'll circulate a first draft MAP (single sheet) by EOD Monday (Sept 4). Laura will own runbook details and Ben will scope training materials.

Action: can you confirm which internal Verdant users will require admin console access (SAML vs SCIM)? That affects our provisioning timeline.

— Nikhil
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachments: none
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Sep 2028 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Draft MAP & evaluation cadence attached

Team —

Attached is a compact MAP (MAP_v1_implementation.xlsx) and a short evaluation cadence doc embedded on sheet 2. Highlights:
- Week 0 (pre-kickoff): account provisioning, SOC2 evidence handoff, test account seeding.
- Week 1 (kickoff, Sept 11): dry-run canary, baseline eval set (50 prompts), SLA run.
- Weeks 2–4: Wave 1 (10%): monitoring + quality regression tests; training workshop A.
- Weeks 5–7: Wave 2 (40%): expanded dataset, latency tuning, train-the-trainer session.
- Week 8: Full cutover, 30-day hypercare.

Evaluation cadence (sheet 2): daily quality snapshot during canary; weekly A/B regression score; nightly token-level cost burn.

Ben — please review training timeline and confirm whether we can compress two office hours into one 3-hr block for Wave 1. Marissa — I'll need your handoff checklist updated with the canary gate text.

Laura
Principal PM, Customer Success | Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP_v1_implementation.xlsx, training-window-proposal.ics
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Sep 2028 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & evaluation cadence attached

Laura —

Thanks for the draft. Quick inputs:
- Training: prefer two shorter sessions (90 min + 90 min) for Wave 1; keeps retention higher for clinical staff. We'll keep office hours as scheduled.
- Canary gates: add a qualitative check (random manual review of 25 responses) in addition to automated metrics.
- Rollback: define a 2-hour rollback window post-cutover for high-risk routes.

I'll update training materials and send a trimmed agenda by EOD.

Ben
Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference

3) Vivek — please prepare the canary runbook (72-hour automation + manual check at 36 hrs) and post it to the runbooks repo; link it into the MAP file.
